mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval through different mechanisms (amitriptyline via sodium channel blockade and anticholinergic effects; moxifloxacin via potassium channel inhibition), increasing risk of torsades de pointes.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes; consider alternative antidepressant or fluoroquinolone; ensure normal potassium and magnesium levels; use with caution in patients with cardiac risk factors.
